actions.description: Advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags.

inputs.description: Transitions to advance; the action is applied at every tick
inputs.name: ticks

inputs.description: The action applied at each tick, shaped by the environment's action space
inputs.name: action

actions.name: step

actions.description: Reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies.

inputs.description: Accepted for the class contract; a MuJoCo reset restores the model defaults (mj_resetData) and does not use a seed
inputs.name: seed

actions.name: reset

facts.text: The repository is teleoperated data collection and imitation learning for a TRLC DK1 bimanual arm pair, with a MuJoCo simulator and WebXR control from a Meta Quest

The two environments are blocks (default), two 4.5 cm cubes and a bowl with the instruction 'put both blocks in the bowl', and dishes, plate, bowl, cup, fork, knife, spoon and a static dish rack with the instruction 'put all the dishes and silverware in the dish rack'
The gripper jaws open to 82 mm; the plate is 277 mm across, the bowl 144 mm and the cup 83 mm
Each environment's scene is generated and committed as assets/trlc_dk1/scene_<env>.xml, one per environment
The blocks scene is an MJCF model whose root element is '<mujoco model="MuJoCo Model">'
The scene compiles angles in radians and resolves mesh files from the model's own directory
The scene selects the implicitfast integrator and sets no timestep: its option element carries only integrator

The left arm has six hinge joints named left_joint1 to left_joint6 with ranges +-2.0944, -0.0872665 to 3.14159, -0.0872665 to 4.71239, -1.95 to 1.5708, +-1.5708 and +-2.0944, and two slide joints left_gripper_left and left_gripper_right with range -0.045 to 0.001

The right arm has six hinge joints named right_joint1 to right_joint6 with ranges +-2.0944, -0.0872665 to 3.14159, -0.0872665 to 4.71239, -1.95 to 1.5708, +-1.5708 and +-2.0944, and two slide joints right_gripper_left and right_gripper_right with range -0.045 to 0.001
The two target bodies left_target and right_target are declared mocap bodies (mocap='true')
The blocks scene places two free-jointed cubes, red_cube and blue_cube, with 0.045 kg box geoms of half-size 0.0225 m, and a free-jointed dish_bowl body
The actuator block has 16 general actuators, eight per arm: one position actuator per hinge joint and per gripper slide joint

The joint actuator control ranges are +-2.0944, -0.0872665 to 3.14159, -0.0872665 to 4.71239, -1.95 to 1.5708, +-1.5708 and +-2.0944 on both arms, and the four gripper actuators have ctrlrange -0.045 to 0.001
The left gripper actuators are force-limited to -20 to 20 and carry a gain of 300
The right gripper actuators are force-limited to -20 to 20 and carry a gain of 300
The dishes scene, the card's second model, has a static dish_rack body with no joint and six free-jointed pieces: dish_plate, dish_bowl, dish_cup, utensil_fork, utensil_knife and utensil_spoon

gaps: the fake backend is a stand-in for the mujoco library, not MuJoCo: it parses the committed MJCF for the actuator control ranges, the joint types and dimensions and the option timestep, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control value, so trajectories, contacts, friction and actuator dynamics are not MuJoCo's
the model states no timestep (the option element carries only the integrator), so the published timestep_ms comes from the stand-in's placeholder library default

no mesh, texture, material, inertia or contact exclusion of the scene is loaded and no contact, equality, tendon or actuator constraint is resolved; the dish_bowl collision hulls and the finger contact tuning are not simulated
the real model resets free joints to their model qpos0; the stand-in resets every qpos to zero, so the initial state after a reset differs

MuJoCo itself was not importable where the gate ran, so no trajectory of this package was compared with the real engine; the real sim path (the official mujoco module loading the same scene) was not run
no viewer, rendering or camera stream is exposed: the package serves only the cap.world.* integration state and control vector, not the scene cameras or the HDRI backdrop
only the card's first model, the blocks scene, is served; the dishes scene and the upstream teleop, capture, WebXR and training stacks are other components and are not part of this driver
no physical TRLC DK1 arm is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware

measures.description: Simulated time since the last reset
measures.name: time_ms

measures.description: Control vector last applied to the actuators (ctrl)
measures.name: ctrl

measures.description: Integration steps since the last reset
measures.name: tick

measures.description: Integration step of the model (null when the model states none)
measures.name: timestep_ms

measures.description: Seed the bridge was configured with
measures.name: seed

measures.description: Declared native checkpoint. Integration profile restores the full native input vector; basic profile restores only advertised state plus actuator activation and exact native time. Neither profile certifies external callbacks, plugins, RNG or hardware fidelity.
measures.name: native_checkpoint

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the integration state is kept and stays readable
